scripts.dev: npm run build:emulators && npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting,auth,firestore
scripts.test:streaks: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cowork-spark "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/spark-backend.test.mjs"
scripts.build:emulators: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && cross-env VITE_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true vite build
scripts.build: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && cross-env VITE_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=false vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:cowork,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cowork-rules "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:emulators && cross-env E2E_USE_PREVIEW=true firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project vigilia-panel "npx playwright test"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:streaks && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:emulators && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project vigilia-panel "node tests/spark-ui-smoke.mjs"
scripts.video:capture: cross-env CAPTURE_TOUR=1 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project vigilia-panel "npx playwright test tests/e2e/tour-capture.spec.ts --project=chromium"
